_doc: 08 SL-3 Radio Chatter and callsigns (I-20, v1): CallsignDef. Singleton file; rule 1 of 08 SL-3 gives the callsign format <Word>-<n>, n = 1 + (hash(entity_id) mod 9). Word lists are only the examples 08 SL-3 names: slot 0 ships (Kestrel, Wren, Swift), Harvester (Crawler), Hauler (Tug). Lists for team slots 1..7 and the other classes are not in the docs and are not invented here; they await owner or content-owner approval (HUM-17 for fiction names).
